articles.title: UN climate talks could end without agreement | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 联合国气候谈判可能在未达成协议的情况下结束 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Negotiations at the COP31 UN climate summit in Turkey are in deadlock and have been suspended for the night, after running more than a day over time, as countries have been unable to agree on a new global climate deal.
 
The EU and Pacific island nations are amongst a group pushing back against the latest draft agreement which included no reference to reducing the world's demand for fossil fuels.
 
Negotiating teams due to fly out on Sunday morning are now moving their flights to Monday in a sign that a deal is not yet in sight.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
在土耳其举行的联合国第31届气候变化大会（COP31）上的谈判陷入僵局，并在超时一天多后暂停至次日，因为各国未能就一项新的全球气候协议达成一致。

欧盟和太平洋岛国是反对最新协议草案的国家之一，该草案中未提及减少全球对化石燃料的需求。

原定于周日早上飞往美国的谈判团队现已将航班改至周一，这表明双方尚未达成协议。

articles.title: All EU options on the table, says UK foreign secretary | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 英国外交大臣表示，所有欧盟选项均在考虑之列 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has said that “all the options will be on the table" as the government considers the future relationship with the European Union.
 
This comes after the prime minister said that he would discuss possible ideas for even closer ties with the bloc in the coming months.
 
Miliband also said that a deal agreed between the UK and the EU on Friday will come into force regardless of whether the two sides can negotiate a separate tuition fees agreement.
 
The measures agreed in Brussels include scrapping most checks on British food exports in return for the UK following some EU regulations from 2028, and a new youth mobility scheme.
 
Subscribe here: http://bit.ly/1rbfUog 

For more news, analysis and features, visit: www.bbc.com/news
 
#UK #EU #BBCNews

articles.readingText:
UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has said that “all the options will be on the table" as the government considers the future relationship with the European Union.

This comes after the prime minister said that he would discuss possible ideas for even closer ties with the bloc in the coming months.

Miliband also said that a deal agreed between the UK and the EU on Friday will come into force regardless of whether the two sides can negotiate a separate tuition fees agreement.

The measures agreed in Brussels include scrapping most checks on British food exports in return for the UK following some EU regulations from 2028, and a new youth mobility scheme.

For more news, analysis and features, visit: www.bbc.com/news
articles.readingTextZh:
英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示，在政府考虑与欧盟的未来关系时，“所有选项都将摆在桌面上”。

在此之前，英国首相表示，他将在未来几个月内讨论与欧盟建立更紧密关系的可能方案。

米利班德还表示，无论英欧双方能否就单独的学费协议进行谈判，周五达成的协议都将生效。

在布鲁塞尔商定的措施包括取消对英国粮食出口的大部分检查，以换取英国从2028年起遵守欧盟的一些法规，以及一项新的青年流动计划。

如需了解更多新闻、分析和专题报道，请访问：www.bbc.com/news

articles.summary: In Bolivia, guinea pig owners and their families gather for the second annual guinea pig fair where attendees could see the animals dressed in elaborate costumes and celebrate Andean traditions.
